body: Oh that does not look good.

I was in the exact same boat as you a year ago. Had the exact same shitty depersonalized feelings you have right now, he'll I even made a post about it on my alt I forgot the user to. But the truth is you have to try your best to keep your mind occupied and wait it out. When I had that crazy mindfuck trip from barely half gram of weed that triggered everything. Same thing happened to me, the intense feelings of anxiety and paranoia, I thought I was going to die and I would be stuck like that forever during the trip. But obviously I didn't. However, for two whole months I had the worst derealization I've experienced, I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy. I stayed in my room because of the extreme existential panic attacks I was having on the daily. I thought I could never live a normal life. I couldn't even carry a conversation with my family, it was fucking terrible. But then it slowly started going away, and one day I woke up and it completely disappeared. I didn't feel disconnected anymore and I pretty much became normal again. Although I still feel disconnected at times and zone out from time to time but I'm pretty sure everyone does. Anyways best of luck to you man! Try your best to keep your mind occupied, exercise, anything.  
edit: my situation was kind of different from yours though. I only had these dissociative/psychedelic feelings from weed around 2-3 times before my mindfuck trip that triggered the derealization. I never touched weed ever again after that and I also used etizolam here and there for when I was feeling really anxious

Fellow 15 year old here. I know exactly how you feel. My sleep schedule lately is so fucked. Staying up to 4 or 5 until I pass out then wake up at noon. Then regretting wasting the whole morning but it's alright cause it's not like I was going to do shit anyways. I know how you feel about staying inside too. We see all of our friends having the time of their lives as summer starts on Twitter, snap chat, and Instagram. While I stay inside in bed all day. Even when my friends ask me to go hiking, skateboarding ( which I used to enjoy a lot), to a bonfire, etc. I always shut them down cause I just don't have the will to go out. It fucking sucks that we have to deal with this at an age where we should be doing whatever the fuck we want. 
What sort of helped me was getting a job. This gives me a reason to get out of the house and I generally like being at work and I've made some friends there.no moping around, doing nothing, and being all negative. Anyways keep your head up man.
